subject: 1 new CNIL decision with collective-action potential
body:
The CNIL published new sanctions that may open a collective action (action de groupe):

- **OPÉRATEUR DE TÉLÉPHONIE MOBILE** · CNIL 2026-01-08 · fine €27.0M · high priority
  Data breach: the CNIL lists "Défaut de sécurité des données"; Victims not properly informed (art. 34) is among the breaches; Fine: €27,000,000
  Decision: https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/cnil/id/CNILTEXT000053352594

Review them and start a case: http://localhost:3000/desk
